title: #44 Moving to Big Cities
prompt: People are moving from rural areas to big cities. Is it good or bad?

promptSegments.text: People are moving from rural areas to big cities.

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.
requirements.vi: Trả lời mọi câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

requirements.en: State a clear and consistent position when an opinion is requested.
requirements.vi: Nêu quan điểm rõ ràng và nhất quán khi đề yêu cầu ý kiến.

requirements.en: Develop each main idea with explanation and an example.
requirements.vi: Phát triển mỗi ý chính bằng giải thích và ví dụ.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The main advantage of moving to big cities is the increased job opportunities.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main advantage of moving to big cities is the increased job opportunities.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The main disadvantage of moving to big cities is the high cost of living.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main disadvantage of moving to big cities is the high cost of living.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that moving to big cities is bad, despite the job opportunities, because of the high cost of living.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that moving to big cities is bad, despite the job opportunities, because of the high cost of living.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay discusses the job opportunities in big cities and the negative impact of the high cost of living on poor families.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay discusses the job opportunities in big cities and the negative impact of the high cost of living on poor families.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The main advantage of moving to big cities is the improved job opportunities and economic status.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main advantage of moving to big cities is the improved job opportunities and economic status.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The main disadvantage of moving to big cities is the high cost of living, which can cause financial stress.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main disadvantage of moving to big cities is the high cost of living, which can cause financial stress.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that moving from rural areas to big cities is a negative development, focusing on job opportunities as a perceived advantage and environmental pollution as a major disadvantage.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that moving from rural areas to big cities is a negative development, focusing on job opportunities as a perceived advantage and environmental pollution as a major disadvantage.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The structure follows the required format: Introduction (3 sentences), Body 1 (PEEL, 5 sentences, starting with 'On the one hand' and focusing on an advantage), Body 2 (PEEL, 5 sentences, starting with 'On the other hand' and focusing on a disadvantage), and Conclusion (1-2 sentences).
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The structure follows the required format: Introduction (3 sentences), Body 1 (PEEL, 5 sentences, starting with 'On the one hand' and focusing on an advantage), Body 2 (PEEL, 5 sentences, starting with 'On the other hand' and focusing on a disadvantage), and Conclusion (1-2 sentences).

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not ignore a direct question in the prompt.
promptTraps.vi: Không bỏ qua câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

modelPlan.focus: Evaluate the impact of urban migration by examining both the benefits and challenges associated with people moving from rural areas to big cities.
keyArguments: Urban migration offers opportunities for better jobs, education, and healthcare, leading to improved living standards.
However, it results in overcrowding, strain on infrastructure, and loss of rural community ties, posing significant challenges.
